name: Tine
author: Erin Carter
description: A single tuning fork standing on a near-black field, drawn as the long-exposure envelope of its own vibration: each tine blooms wider where its swing is largest and stays needle-sharp at the yoke. A faint ladder of fixed interference fringes hangs between the tines. Hash-spaced strikes flood the envelope, then it narrows exponentially toward a hairline as the note rings down.

params.label: Tine gap
params.effect: CSS-pixel spacing between the two tines, also re-spacing the interference ladder hung between them.

params.label: Strike swing
params.effect: Peak blur width at the tine tips just after a strike, from a tight hum to a wide soft bloom.

params.label: Strike spacing
params.effect: Mean seconds between strikes and softer mid-decay touches on the fork.

params.label: Ring time
params.effect: How slowly the envelope narrows back toward a hairline after each strike.
